# `aitbc agent config-set`

Set a configuration key and value for a named agent.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc agent config-set [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--name` | text | — | yes | Agent name. |
| `--key` | text | — | yes | The Key. |
| `--value` | text | — | yes | The Value. |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc agent config-set --name <name> --key <key> --value <value>
```
